reflection: Nothing has joined the team yet. Almost every factor fails in 2024, a strong trending year, and often 2022. The best signals are relative: aapl_rel_peer_volume_gap (3-day Apple vs peer mean) helped both LR and RF, and it paired with the NVDA/QQQ volume factor. Single-day Apple candle features flip sign across years. Next I will try multi-day relative moves that are robust to trend, volume-based peer-state variables, and relative moves scaled by volatility. I will avoid heavy-tailed ratios and near-copies of existing factors.

lessons.name: peer_dispersion_z20
lessons.lesson: Z-scoring the dispersion destroyed the level information RF used and made it unstable, giving a big loss in 2024.

lessons.name: aapl_close_position_range_sign_vol
lessons.lesson: Scaling the candle position by relative range helped LR a little but is still a one-day Apple pattern that flipped in 2024.

lessons.name: aapl_signed_volume_surge
lessons.lesson: It was largely a rescaled copy of AAPL_return_1d (0.85 similarity), so it added noise rather than information.

lessons.name: nvda_qqq_volume_ratio_change
lessons.lesson: Relative NVDA-vs-QQQ volume activity gave RF some information in 2023 and 2025 but is regime dependent, so it works best only as a partner of the relative-move factor.

lessons.name: aapl_rel_peer_volume_gap
lessons.lesson: The 3-day Apple-vs-peer gap is the most robust idea so far, helping both models in three years, but it failed in the trending 2024 where relative moves persisted.

lessons.name: msft_lead_qqq_residual
lessons.lesson: MSFT's residual vs QQQ is mostly noise and overlaps MSFT_return_1d, so it hurt in 2022 and 2024.

factors.name: aapl_rel_peer_5d_vol_scaled
factors.hypothesis: The 3d gap failed in 2024 when the vol regime was low and gaps small in scale; scaling by Apple's 20d vol and using a 5d window makes the relative signal comparable across regimes.

factors.name: nvda_qqq_volume_gap_smooth
factors.hypothesis: The one-day volume ratio is noisy and flipped in 2022 and 2024; using 5d over 60d averages gives a smoother measure of speculative tech attention.

factors.name: aapl_vs_qqq_3d_gap
factors.hypothesis: The multi-day Apple minus QQQ gap is a short-term mean-reversion signal against the index, analogous to the peer gap that worked, but with a different benchmark.

factors.name: qqq_range_expansion
factors.hypothesis: The market's intraday range relative to its norm describes stress/regime state; high stress days tend to be followed by rebounds, which the existing Apple-only features miss.

factors.name: aapl_peer_gap_regime_interaction
factors.hypothesis: Relative-move reversion should be stronger when the market is in a rising-vol state; this interaction conditions the parent on QQQ vol regime so the two give more than the sum.

factors.name: nvda_msft_lead_5d_spread
factors.hypothesis: The 3-day NVDA-minus-MSFT spread shows which direction the tech leaders are rotating (risk-on vs defensive), complementing the NVDA volume-attention state to predict whether Apple follows.
